leadText:
The showman (Japanese: 座長 ringmaster) is a character of the day who appeared in Out of Their Elements!.

The showman is the owner of a Pokémon circus that visited Vermilion City. He met , Goh, and Chloe who visited his circus. Before a performance, two of his performers accidentally had their evolve into and which they'd planned to do during their upcoming performance.

After and were able come up with a new routine with their Pokémon, the performance went ahead with Ash, Goh, and Chloe taking part.
